moves.text: Keep Jonah Coleman at FLEX over Ollie Gordon II, and set the holiday slots before Thu 1 PM
moves.why: Coleman (16.0 @ PIT) had 24 carries for 111 yards and 3 TDs in Week 11; Gordon (14.0 vs NYJ) had 11 carries. ESPN lists both healthy and there are no Week 12 byes. Three starters lock early: Gibbs Thu 1 PM vs CHI, Moore Thu 8:20 PM vs KC, Coleman Fri 3 PM @ PIT. Gordon and Tyson play Sun 1 PM, so if Coleman pops up on DEN's injury report you can still swap him out before Fri 3 PM.

moves.text: I disagree with 'no waiver move': drop Rachaad White and check waivers for a WR
moves.why: White projects 1.7 at ARI and only returned two kickoffs Monday (48 yards). Your only WRs are Evans, Moore and Tyson, while the bench holds 3 QBs (Purdy, Mendoza, Young) and 2 D/STs. The roster also shows 15 players after Shrader was dropped, so check ESPN's 'Pending Moves 1' first: if it's a claim it may already fill the open spot. Waiver order is 10 of 12.
